generation.requested_resolution: Highest available square resolution, ideally at least 2048 x 2048
generation.note: The built-in tool exposes no explicit size control. Three source textures were generated; the matching height map is derived deterministically from the finished dermis to preserve exact fold registration.

postprocessing.source_preservation: Unmodified generated PNGs are retained under textures/sources/.
operations: Convert source to grayscale. Gaussian blur at source resolution; dermis restores 0.08 * (original - blurred) for restrained pores.

Crossfade an overlap of 188 source pixels in each axis with smoothstep t*t*(3-2*t), reducing the tile from 1254 to 1066 pixels. For coordinates within the overlap, blend source[x+1066] toward source[x], and similarly in Y; use their separable product for corners. No mirroring.
Normalize using target + limit * tanh((value - mean) * requested_stddev / (actual_stddev * limit)). Round to 8-bit for resampling.
Membrane only: add -1.4*sin(2*pi*x/(1066-1)) to provide a subtle periodic right-side lift with matching boundary values.
Resize the seamless 1066 x 1066 result to 2048 x 2048 with Lanczos3, without sharpening.

Match opposing endpoint values to their average using a 32-pixel smoothstep correction band, horizontal then vertical. At distance j from each edge, add (average - edgeValue) * (1 - 3*t*t + 2*t*t*t), t=j/31. Do not extrapolate pixel slopes.

Height only: repeat finished dermis 3 x 3, Gaussian blur sigma 8 at final resolution, crop the central 2048 square, then apply the same 32-pixel endpoint correction. Light means raised. This is a luminance-derived artistic height map, not a measured physical displacement scan.
Encode final grayscale-valued PNGs without alpha. No material color, emission or anatomy is baked in.
postprocessing.review_layout: Each row: 2 x 2 tiles at 256 px each, a 512 px preview offset 50 percent on both axes, and a single 128 px Lanczos3 reduction. Opposing edges measured on full 2048 px files.
postprocessing.rejected_processing: The initial derivative-extrapolating boundary correction introduced stripes and was rejected after visual offset review. The delivered files use overlap crossfades.
postprocessing.verification: Reviewed final review.png after correction. No visible straight seams or granular noise at thumbnail scale; repeated motifs remain discernible, as expected for a single tile.

textures.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless square grayscale material structure texture for Blender cephalopod skin, NOT a creature illustration. Generate at the highest available square resolution, ideally at least 2048x2048. One continuous edge-to-edge flat orthographic top-down swatch, no anatomy. Interlocking soft muscle folds and flowing longitudinal furrows, predominantly vertical, with only 6 to 10 broad folds across the full width. Moderate mesoscopic frequency, softly rounded organic ridges, gentle branching and interlocking, uneven natural spacing. Extremely fine quiet pores between folds, almost imperceptible, absolutely no dots or speckles. Compact middle gray value range around 128/255, approximately 108 to 150, neutral grayscale. Treat values as structure: raised folds softly lighter, furrows softly darker, no directional shaded side. Flat neutral uniform illumination, no shadows, no highlights, no vignette, no broad illumination gradient. Opposing edges should seamlessly continue. Must remain calm coherent midtones at 128px game-size downsampling. No black or white, dark points, freckles, chromatophores, scales, hexagons, warts, gritty noise, cracks, stones, fabric, metal, wet gloss, object silhouette, eyes, tentacles, borders, text, labels or watermark. Fill the entire image with the material.

validation.self_assessment: Soft interlocking longitudinal folds remain legible at 128 px; fine pores are subdued and there are no dark freckles.

textures.tool: deterministic sharp derivation; no separate image-generation call

lane_i.scope: Additional scale / scar-skin textures. Existing generation and postprocessing fields above describe the earlier dermis / membrane / egg batch only.
lane_i.tool: built-in image_gen; deterministic Node.js + sharp finishing
operations: Convert generated sources to neutral grayscale; source Gaussian sigma 0.7 px for scales, 1.2 px for underside.
Scales: 100 px overlap in each source axis, minimum squared-error seam (successive positions differ by at most 1 px), 4 px smoothstep feather. Tile before resize: 1154 x 1154.
Underside: 188 px smoothstep overlap in each source axis. Tile before resize: 1066 x 1066. This replaces the rejected narrow seam, which interrupted folds visibly in the 50-percent-offset review.
Normalize with 128 + limit*tanh((value-mean)*requested_stddev/(actual_stddev*limit)); scales stddev 16 / limit 48; underside stddev 8 / limit 25.
Lanczos3 resize to 2048 x 2048. Average opposing endpoint values using an 8 px smoothstep correction band in X then Y.

Height: derive from final scales in the identical pixel phase; wrap-aware Gaussian sigma 2 px, remap 128+(value-128)*1.6, then same endpoint correction. No independent image synthesis or shifted structures.
Save opaque grayscale-valued PNGs. Blender structure and height maps should be interpreted as Non-Color data.

verification.review_layout: Each row: 2x2 repeat with 256 px tiles, a 512 px preview offset exactly 50 percent in both source axes, one 128 px view.

verification.opposing_edges: All three final maps have maximum endpoint difference 0/255 in X and Y.
verification.size_note: Image generation returned 1254 px sources; delivered maps are resized to 2048 px, not natively generated 2K.
